children: LOS ANGELES, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Insta360 today announced Luna Pro, its newest addition to Luna Series gimbal cameras co-engineered with Leica.

Designed around the needs of today's lifestyle creators, Luna Pro combines high-end imaging with a fast, flexible approach to content creation. Native 4K Vertical Video makes it easy to capture high-quality content for short-form platforms, while AI-powered tracking, intuitive controls, and streamlined editing help creators work quickly when shooting solo or on the move.

A Leica Summicron lens, 1-inch 8K sensor, 8K Dolby Vision video, 10-bit I-Log, and built-in timecode give Luna Pro the imaging quality and workflow tools to take on more demanding creative projects as well.

Professional Imaging
Luna Pro pairs a Leica Summicron lens with a 1-inch 8K sensor for exceptional detail and strong low-light performance.
Its Dual AI Chip architecture combines a dedicated imaging chip with a 4nm flagship chip, providing the processing power needed for advanced imaging and intelligent shooting features.

For creators producing short-form content, Luna Pro supports native 4K30fps Vertical Video with 6K oversampling for greater clarity and detail. Rotate the touchscreen to switch orientation and start shooting vertical content in 4K.
Luna Pro also records 8K Dolby Vision video for rich detail, color, and dynamic range. For slow motion capture, it supports 4K120fps and 1080p240fps recording.
Up to 2× lossless zoom and 4× HighRes Zoom give creators more freedom to reframe or get closer to distant subjects, with AI-powered enhancement helping preserve image clarity at higher zoom levels.
Smooth, Flexible Shooting
Luna Pro's 3-axis stabilization keeps footage smooth and steady, while AI-powered Deep Track and Rapid Focus help keep moving subjects sharp and in frame.

The detachable 2-inch OLED touchscreen makes it easier to compose and monitor shots from different angles. Slide-to-start recording and twist-to-shoot controls also reduce the time between picking up the camera and getting the shot.

With up to 4 hours of battery life and 47GB of built-in storage, Luna Pro is equipped for longer shooting sessions without frequent charging or storage changes. It also connects directly to the Insta360 Mic Series for high-quality wireless audio capture.
More Ways to Create

The POV Head Tracker opens up new possibilities for immersive first-person content, while NFC lets compatible phones connect to the Insta360 app with a simple tap for faster access to files and editing.
Luna Pro also offers Leica color profiles including Leica Natural, Leica Vivid, and Leica Chrome, alongside a range of cinematic filters for distinctive looks straight out of the camera.
For creators who want more control in post-production, 10-bit I-Log preserves more color information and highlight and shadow detail, with support for ACES workflows for professional color grading.

Built-in timecode simplifies synchronization in multi-camera productions and integrates into workflows using Final Cut Pro and Adobe Premiere Pro. AI-powered editing tools in the Insta360 app can also turn footage into polished content, particularly when speed matters.
Availability & Pricing
Insta360 Luna Pro is available starting
September 10
via the Insta360 Store, Amazon, and select retailers worldwide. Pricing for the Standard Bundle starts at US$599.99.

Insta360 Global Awards 2026 Supported by Leica

To inspire creators to push the boundaries of visual storytelling, the Insta360 Global Awards 2026 are now open for submissions. The global competition invites creators to showcase their vision and creativity through original photo and video works captured with Insta360 or Antigravity devices.
Submissions can be made through the Insta360 website, social media channels, or the Insta360 app. Entries opened on June 15 and close on October 31, with winners announced on November 30.
Prizes include:

: 3 winners, prizes valued at US$7,500+ each
